newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight - String of orders, fixtures reported.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight - String of orders, fixtures reported.

text.p: The sugar freight market saw a string of new orders and fixtures on Thursday but prices were not immediately available, shipbrokers said.
New orders included Cargill for 12,000-14,000 tonnes bagged or bulk from Thailand to South Korea for Jan-Feb. Glencore was in for 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar Brazil/Umm Qasr for Feb 1/10.
Other new orders were Alpine for 25,000 tonnes bulk Cuba/Black Sea for Feb 1/10 and Dreyfus for 9,500 tonnes bulk sugar Puerto Quetzal/US Gulf or Atlantic for prompt shipment.
Cargill was reported to have fixed 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar from the Continent to Tunisia/Egypt or Syria at end-Jan.
